title_jp: {二人|ふたり}でお{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}
context: Sunday 20 December: {恵子|けいこ}さん and {田中|たなか}さん are in {長野市|ながのし} buying お{歳暮|せいぼ} at the last minute, so アルちゃん and {颯太|そうた} must make lunch. On the family LINE, 'what ifs' turn into a plan: アルちゃん will cook paella tonight.
scene: Sunday. The {田中|たなか}s are in {長野|ながの} buying year-end gifts. Lunch is up to you and {颯太|そうた}, with {恵子|けいこ}さん's instructions on LINE.

phrases.jp: これを{入れる|いれる}と、もっと{美味しく|おいしく}なるよ。
phrases.en: If you put this in, it gets even tastier.
phrases.note: A と B: whenever A, B follows naturally. Perfect for cooking tips.

phrases.jp: もし{失敗|しっぱい|failure, mistake|4}したら、どうしよう。
phrases.en: What if I mess it up?
phrases.note: もし〜たら, どうしよう = what'll I do if…

phrases.jp: {味見|あじみ|tasting (while cooking)|3}してもいい？
phrases.note: Said by whoever hovers near the pan.

phrases.jp: ちょっと{味|あじ|taste, flavour|4}が{薄い|うすい|weak, bland|3}かも。
phrases.en: It might be a bit bland.
phrases.note: {味|あじ}が{薄|うす}い = bland; {濃|こ}い = strong, rich.

phrases.jp: {私|わたし}だったら、もう{少し|すこし}{塩|しお}を{入れます|いれます}。
phrases.en: If it were me, I'd add a bit more salt.
phrases.note: {私|わたし}だったら = if I were you: soft advice.

dialogue_setting: The {田中|たなか} family LINE group, Sunday late morning. You and {颯太|そうた} are in the kitchen; {恵子|けいこ}さん is at a department store in {長野|ながの}.

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: お{歳暮|せいぼ|year-end gift|2}、ギリギリ{買えた|かえた}〜！お{昼|ひる}は{二人|ふたり}でお{願い|ねがい}ね🙏
dialogue.en: Just made it with the year-end gifts! Lunch is up to you two, please 🙏

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: {冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ|fridge|4}に{焼きそば|やきそば}があるよ。{強火|つよび|high heat|3}で{炒める|いためる|to stir-fry|3}と、すぐ{焦げる|こげる|to burn (food)|3}からね
dialogue.en: There's yakisoba in the fridge. Fry it on high heat and it burns in no time, so careful.

dialogue.speaker: 颯太
dialogue.jp: もしアルちゃんが{作ったら|つくったら}、スペインの{味|あじ|taste, flavour|4}になる？ｗ
dialogue.en: If アルちゃん makes it, will it taste Spanish? lol

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {焼きそば|やきそば}は{作った|つくった}{経験|けいけん|experience|3}ないｗ でも、パエリアなら{得意|とくい}だよ
dialogue.en: I've never made yakisoba lol. But paella, that I'm good at.

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: パエリア！？{材料|ざいりょう}があったら、{夜|よる}{作って|つくって}ほしいな
dialogue.en: Paella?! If we have the ingredients, I'd love you to make it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: エビとイカがあると、もっと{美味しく|おいしく}なるんだけど…
dialogue.en: If there's prawns and squid, it gets even better, but…

dialogue.speaker: 恵子さん
dialogue.jp: じゃあ{帰り|かえり}に{買って|かって}くるね！{台所|だいどころ}、{片付けて|かたづけて|to tidy up|4}おいてね〜
dialogue.en: Then I'll buy them on the way back! Tidy the kitchen for me, OK?

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: ごめん、{焦げちゃった|こげちゃった|to burn (food)|3}…{颯太|そうた}が{混ぜる|まぜる|to mix, stir|3}のやめなくてｗ
dialogue.en: Sorry, it burned… {颯太|そうた} wouldn't stop stirring lol

dialogue.speaker: 颯太
dialogue.jp: {焦げた|こげた|to burn (food)|3}とこが{一番|いちばん}うまいんだって！
dialogue.en: The burnt bits are the best part, though!
dialogue.note: とこ = ところ; うまい = {美味|おい}しい (boys' casual).

listening.intro: Behind {恵子|けいこ}さん's voice message, you can hear the department store speakers.
listening.title: デパートの{放送|ほうそう}
listening.place: {長野市|ながのし}のデパート

lines.jp: お{客様|きゃくさま}にお{知らせ|しらせ}いたします。{地下|ちか}1{階|かい}{食品|しょくひん|food (goods)|3}{売り場|うりば|sales floor|3}より、
lines.en: Announcement to all customers. From the basement food floor:

lines.jp: {午後|ごご}3{時|じ}から、{魚|さかな}のタイムセールを{行います|おこないます}。
lines.en: from 3 p.m. there will be a time sale on fish.

listening.question: タイムセールは、どこで{何時|なんじ}からですか。
listening.explain: {地下|ちか}1{階|かい}, {午後|ごご}3{時|じ}から: basement floor 1, from 3 p.m.

grammar.meaning: whenever / if A then naturally B
grammar.form: verb dictionary form + と ({炒|いた}めると, {入|い}れると) · ない-form + と ({入|い}れないと) · い-adj + と ({強|つよ}いと) · noun / な-adj + だと ({強火|つよび}だと)
grammar.explanation: A と B: when A happens, B always or automatically follows, like a rule, a machine, or nature. Great for recipes and directions. B can't be a wish, request or invitation: say {材料|ざいりょう}があったら{作|つく}ってほしい, not があると.

examples.jp: このボタンを{押す|おす}と、ご{飯|はん}が{炊けます|たけます|to cook (rice)|3}。
examples.en: Press this button and the rice cooks.

examples.jp: {右|みぎ}に{曲がる|まがる}と、{駅|えき}が{見えます|みえます}。
examples.en: Turn right and you'll see the station.

quiz.question: {冬|ふゆ}になる＿＿、{鷹ノ原|たかのはら}は{雪|ゆき}が{降る|ふる}。
quiz.en: When winter comes, it snows in {鷹ノ原|たかのはら}.

quiz_more.question: {塩|しお}を{入れ|いれ}＿＿、{味|あじ}が{薄い|うすい}よ。
quiz_more.en: If you don't add salt, it's bland.
quiz_more.explain: ない-form + と: without salt, it's always bland.

quiz_more.question: {時間|じかん}が＿＿、{一緒|いっしょ}に{作ろう|つくろう}。
quiz_more.en: If you have time, let's cook together.
quiz_more.explain: The second half is an invitation, so と can't be used: 〜たら.

kanji.where: Printed on the yakisoba packet you pull out of the fridge.
kanji.breakdown: {賞|しょう} enjoy, prize + {味|み} taste + {期限|きげん} time limit → the deadline for enjoying the taste: best before.
kanji.related: {消費期限|しょうひきげん} = use-by date (eat it before then to be safe).

tip.title: Gifts with a deadline
tip.body: お{歳暮|せいぼ}, the year-end thank-you gift, should arrive by around 20 December. Miss it, and you send it in early January as お{年賀|ねんが} instead, or later as a {寒中見舞|かんちゅうみま}い.

challenge.prompt: {恵子|けいこ}さん: 「パエリアって、どうすると{美味しく|おいしく}なるの？」 Tell her it gets tasty if you turn the heat up high at the end.
challenge.model_answer: {最後|さいご}に{強火|つよび|high heat|3}にすると、{美味しく|おいしく}なりますよ。
challenge.explanation: {強火|つよび}にすると: 'when you turn it to high heat', the condition, and {美味|おい}しくなります is the natural result, so と fits. In Spain this crispy bottom is the socarrat, like Japanese お{焦|こ}げ.

vocab.note: {歳|さい} year + {暮|ぼ} end. Summer version: お{中元|ちゅうげん}.
{冷|れい} cold + {蔵|ぞう} storehouse + {庫|こ} store. Freezer: {冷凍庫|れいとうこ}.
{野菜炒|やさいいた}め = stir-fried vegetables.
Same kanji as {焦|あせ}る (panic). お{焦|こ}げ = the crispy burnt bit.
{味|あじ}がする = tastes of. {味見|あじみ} = tasting.
{片付|かたづ}けておいて = tidy it up (in advance) for me.
{失敗|しっぱい}する. Opposite: {成功|せいこう}.
{味|あじ} taste + {見|み}る try → have a little taste.
Also thin (a book) and light (a colour).

kanji_study.kun: ま(ぜる)・ま(ざる)・こ(む)
kanji_study.parts: 氵 water radical + 昆 many small creatures crowded together → lots of things swirling in water: mix, crowded.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 泥 (mud): 泥 has 尼 on the right, 混 has 昆 (日 over 比).

kanji_study.parts: 糸 thread + 圣 the warp threads on a loom → the long threads everything passes along: pass through, go through (experience).
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 軽 (light): 軽 has 車 car on the left, 経 has 糸 thread.

extras.title: Kitchen heat
extras.intro: Every Japanese recipe says one of these.

items.note: {弱火|よわび}で{煮|に}る = simmer gently.

items.jp: もし{雪|ゆき}が{降ったら|ふったら}、どうする？
items.en: What will you do if it snows?

items.jp: {僕|ぼく}だったら、{断る|ことわる|to refuse|3}かな。
items.en: If it were me, I'd probably say no.

items.jp: お{金|かね}があれば、{毎日|まいにち}{外食|がいしょく}したい。
items.en: If I had money, I'd eat out every day.
